scope: Static target-native pipeline review, exact native hook transformations on two Morphe SDKs, and symbolic ABI verification. No Android runtime or clean original APK full apply is claimed.
apk_provenance: Previously modified archived SwiftKey Beta 9.13.16.4 v2 APK. All six hook methods still match exact target native fingerprints.

native_reset_chain.classification: rb0/j.a uses a commit-text-only early no-op, and treats every non-EXPANDED event as reset even for the same query. EXPANDED is append only when the complete old commit prefix remains. rb0/d.j subscribes all event types, so the view must not assume every update received while expanded has type g.
native_reset_chain.fanout: fb0/u.h calls d(reset) on every observer (fb0/u:209-236). p10/a is WeakHashMap.keySet iteration (p10/a:60-70), so panel/adapter order is not guaranteed.
native_reset_chain.panel: rb0/d.d(true) invokes virtual a() (rb0/d:52-59), reaching rb0/k.a. Original a resets n/o/p/q, refreshes H, clears rb0/l.c, and then calls RecyclerView.w0(0) (rb0/k:287-312).
native_reset_chain.stop_scroll: RecyclerView.w0 first calls F0, which sets idle, removes the flinger callback and aborts OverScroller (RecyclerView:12982-13009 and 3984-3999). Merely restoring the position later would not restore momentum.
native_reset_chain.fix_surface: Only the panel scroll-to-zero invocation is conditionally delegated. All preceding bookkeeping, H/notify, and all adapter notifications remain. The provider original notifier call is delegated once through a synchronous try/finally scope; outside that scope the helper forwards the exact original view.w0(position).

anchor_semantics.same_query_guard: The full established Japanese query/context comparison is retained. Visible, attached, unambiguously owned expanded panels can preserve any incoming result type. Changed input/context, mismatched parent panel/adapter/listener, unavailable geometry, unknown pending scroll, and no surviving visible anchor retain native fallback.
anchor_semantics.fresh_identity: Within the eligible displayed grid, surviving old candidates retain their relative order, using duplicate occurrence queues and exclusively fresh incoming objects. Missing old candidates are dropped; unmatched new candidates append in incoming order. Matching includes display, commit, prediction input, and separator. The first surviving visible candidate retains its recorded decorated offset, subject to native content bounds.
anchor_semantics.decorated_offset: capture uses layout.r.e(child)-layout.r.k(). Vertical ra/m1.e is child top minus item-decoration top inset minus topMargin (m1:93-116,a2:175-194); k is RecyclerView paddingTop (m1:187-198,a2:992-1003). Raw child.getTop alone would be incorrect.
anchor_semantics.restore: LinearLayoutManager.l1(position,offset) is public final and sets public x/y before requestLayout, without RecyclerView.stopScroll (LinearLayoutManager:3925-3943). GridLayoutManager.g1 normalizes the anchor to its row boundary (GridLayoutManager:2402-2484).
anchor_semantics.repeated_before_layout: Weak viewport/list identity and geometry are carried only while native public x/y equal the helper-issued pending anchor. Native k0 clears x=-1 and y=Integer.MIN_VALUE after layout (LinearLayoutManager:3790-3803). Once cleared, a new visible snapshot is captured rather than using stale child positions.
anchor_semantics.early_no_dispatch: Normal same-count/same-full-key no-ops remain native. canSkipSameResult is consulted only after native equal-count/commit-text comparison succeeds. It returns false only for the exact prepared incoming container, fresh element identity sequence, previous provider list, epoch, visible owner and full same query. Native original update body then builds fresh actors. This covers same-size order stabilization and distinct display candidates sharing commit text.
anchor_semantics.commit_prefix_is_not_ui_identity: Native m40/x can expose a display suffix while delegating the underlying commit. Therefore commit-only prefix equality does not prove visible candidate indices are stable. prepareUpdate skips ordinary append preparation only for a full candidate-key prefix; every eligible prepared reset=false update also applies its anchor. tryAppend retains native G measurements and rebinds the entire previous range with a non-null payload.
anchor_semantics.smaller_limit: A result whose request.g is strictly smaller than the displayed request is ignored only for the same semantic query/provider and an owned viewport already scrolled away from origin (or its exact pending anchor). The returned container points to the current provider list so the native no-op retains the newer displayed actors. Empty/changed-query, hidden/detached, first-display, unrelated pending scroll and reattach-to-zero cases do not inherit this suppression.

watermark_semantics.risk: rb0/l.b ignores dx/dy, and when W0()>c it requests EXPANDED candidates before assigning c=W0 (rb0/l:33-58). Keeping c=0 after a preserved reset could cause layout-only updates to request again.
watermark_semantics.zero_delta_native_path: RecyclerView completes layout.k0 at 2638-2640, exits the layout counter through i0 at 2644, then calls F(0,0) when the visible range changed at 2660-2690. F forwards to scroll listeners (3917-3968). c0 checks only F>0 (5452 onward); i0 decrements and resets F to zero (7495 onward). Thus the ordinary post-layout callback passes the helper !c0 guard.
watermark_semantics.fetch_path: wb0/x.Y forwards through wb0/h1.b/c to ib0/p.b, which creates a GetPredictionFluencyTask and submits it to the service (x:1240-1265,h1:103-137,p:231-243). The request is substantive, not an inert observer update.
watermark_semantics.fix: A viewport now binds the exact panel.n at capture by verifying RecyclerView.getParent() is rb0/k, with panel.l==view, panel.m==adapter and panel.n.b==layout. This native direct-parent relation is created in rb0/k constructor. Both reset=true and reset=false prepared anchors therefore rebase only their owned post-layout 0/0 callback, then consume the token. A first nonzero callback consumes without modifying c; subsequent real row advance keeps native fetching.
watermark_semantics.ordering: Original adapter notifications schedule future layout. The scoped panel helper records the token synchronously before returning from native notification, and both listener orders are covered by runtime tests. Nested/unknown computing-layout states fail closed.

lifecycle_and_accessibility.active_scope: dispatchUpdate installs eligibility only for its synchronous original notifier call and restores/removes the previous ThreadLocal in finally, including nested/throwing callbacks.
lifecycle_and_accessibility.normal_return: finishUpdate is reached on every normal provider return, including equal-result and no-notifier paths. Replacing the original labeled return with finishUpdate before adding return-void keeps branch targets correct.
lifecycle_and_accessibility.pre_dispatch_exception_limit: A native exception before dispatch can leave a dormant weak plan until the next update or provider collection. It has weak candidate/view/provider references and geometry only, installs no active ThreadLocal, and cannot suppress any panel scroll outside dispatch. This is not an Android exception execution test.
lifecycle_and_accessibility.accessibility: Native LayoutManagerProvider/ra.z0.m focus restoration, RecyclerView accessibility dispatch, and AccessibilityEmptyRecyclerView adapter observer oi0/b are unchanged. The change does not intercept arbitrary scroll or accessibility actions.
lifecycle_and_accessibility.layout_policy: Native candidate width calculation and grid packing remain. Existing candidate-only ItemAnimator suppression and append/payload behavior are retained.
lifecycle_and_accessibility.no_new_lifecycle_hook: No global lifecycle, focus, accessibility, or scroll hook was added. Native rb0/k.onDetached sets r=false; onAttached first calls super, whose cached-result delivery precedes r=true/G/notify and final w0(0). The helper rejects that unrelated pending-to-zero state and does not suppress small initial results at the unscrolled origin.

rejected_hypotheses: Ordinary ROMAJI/HIRAGANA native requests do select JAPANESE; no evidence justified weakening the search-type guard.
Native provider/notifier ownership is the same constructor object, and result delivery is queued through the main Handler.
Sequence/TouchHistory use semantic native equality; no evidence justified dropping surrounding-context comparison.
Explicit LinearLayoutManager x/y pending anchors precede focused-child selection; no evidence justified changing global focus behavior.
